insurer_name: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
specific_diseases_listed: Internal tumors, cysts, nodules, polyps, skin tumors
Surgery of varicose veins and varicose ulcers
sub_limits_waiting_notes: 30-day initial waiting (Excl03); 24-month specific disease waiting (Excl02); 48-month PED waiting (Excl01).

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to sum insured; room rent, ICU charges, surgeon fees, anaesthesia, drugs, diagnostics included

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day care procedures listed in Appendix 1
day_care_treatments.notes: Procedures <24 hours under general/local anaesthesia covered

domiciliary_treatment.notes: When patient cannot be moved to hospital or hospital room unavailable

maternity_coverage.notes: Optional maternity benefit; if opted with waiting period; limited to 2 deliveries/terminations during lifetime

newborn_coverage.notes: Applicable if Maternity benefit is opted and a maternity claim accepted; coverage starts upon premium receipt

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Pre/post hospitalisation of donor not covered

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Rs.2,000 per hospitalisation for SI 1L-15L; Rs.5,000 for SI 20L-50L

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: E-opinion in respect of 8 Critical Illnesses (Cancer, Open Chest CABG, First Heart Attack, Kidney Failure, Major Organ/Bone Marrow Transplant, Multiple Sclerosis, Permanent Paralysis of Limbs, Stroke)
critical_illness_cover.notes: E-opinion benefit only; lump sum CI cover via optional rider

restoration_benefit.notes: Not explicitly stated as base benefit; Multiplier Benefit (cumulative bonus) mentioned

preventive_health_checkup.notes: Health Checkup benefit referenced; subject to product variant

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Treatment availed outside India excluded under in-patient treatment; all payments in INR within India

permanent_exclusions: Rest cure, rehabilitation and respite care (Excl05)
Treatment for Alcoholism, drug or substance abuse (Excl12)
Dietary supplements and substances bought without prescription (Excl14)
War, civil war, nuclear, biological, chemical contamination
temporary_exclusions: 30-day initial waiting period for non-accident claims
notable_exclusions_summary: Investigation-only admissions, cosmetic surgery, refractive errors, infertility/sterility, weight-control treatments, hazardous sports as professional, treatment outside India, and self-inflicted injury are permanently excluded. Maternity is excluded unless the rider is opted. 30-day initial wait for illnesses, 24-month wait for ENT/cataract/hernia/hysterectomy/joint replacement, and 48-month PED wait apply.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via empanelled HDFC ERGO network with pre-authorisation by TPA; reimbursement claims to be intimated within stipulated timelines with bills, discharge summary and KYC documents.
